50 class AI:
51     """
52     A class that interfaces with language models for conversation management and message serialization.
53 
54     This class provides methods to start and advance conversations, handle message serialization,
55     and implement backoff strategies for rate limit errors when interacting with the OpenAI API.
56 
57     Attributes
58     ----------
59     temperature : float
60         The temperature setting for the language model.
61     azure_endpoint : str
62         The endpoint URL for the Azure-hosted language model.
63     model_name : str
64         The name of the language model to use.
65     streaming : bool
66         A flag indicating whether to use streaming for the language model.
67     llm : BaseChatModel
68         The language model instance for conversation management.
69     token_usage_log : TokenUsageLog
70         A log for tracking token usage during conversations.
71 
72     Methods
73     -------
74     start(system: str, user: str, step_name: str) -> List[Message]
75         Start the conversation with a system message and a user message.
76     next(messages: List[Message], prompt: Optional[str], step_name: str) -> List[Message]
77         Advances the conversation by sending message history to LLM and updating with the response.
78     backoff_inference(messages: List[Message]) -> Any
79         Perform inference using the language model with an exponential backoff strategy.
80     serialize_messages(messages: List[Message]) -> str
81         Serialize a list of messages to a JSON string.
82     deserialize_messages(jsondictstr: str) -> List[Message]
83         Deserialize a JSON string to a list of messages.
84     _create_chat_model() -> BaseChatModel
85         Create a chat model with the specified model name and temperature.
86     """

116     def start(self, system: str, user: Any, *, step_name: str) -> List[Message]:
117         """
118         Start the conversation with a system message and a user message.
119 
120         Parameters
121         ----------
122         system : str
123             The content of the system message.
124         user : str
125             The content of the user message.
126         step_name : str
127             The name of the step.
128 
129         Returns
130         -------
131         List[Message]
132             The list of messages in the conversation.
133         """
134 
135         messages: List[Message] = [
136             SystemMessage(content=system),
137             HumanMessage(content=user),
138         ]
139         return self.next(messages, step_name=step_name)
140 
141     def _extract_content(self, content):
142         """
143         Extracts text content from a message, supporting both string and list types.
144         Parameters
145         ----------
146         content : Union[str, List[dict]]
147             The content of a message, which could be a string or a list.
148         Returns
149         -------
150         str
151             The extracted text content.
152         """
153         if isinstance(content, str):
154             return content
155         elif isinstance(content, list) and content and "text" in content[0]:
156             # Assuming the structure of list content is [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Some text'}, ...]
157             return content[0]["text"]
158         else:
159             return ""
160 
161     def _collapse_text_messages(self, messages: List[Message]):
162         """
163         Combine consecutive messages of the same type into a single message, where if the message content
164         is a list type, the first text element's content is taken. This method keeps `combined_content` as a string.
165 
166         This method iterates through the list of messages, combining consecutive messages of the same type
167         by joining their content with a newline character. If the content is a list, it extracts text from the first
168         text element's content. This reduces the number of messages and simplifies the conversation for processing.
169 
170         Parameters
171         ----------
172         messages : List[Message]
173             The list of messages to collapse.
174 
175         Returns
176         -------
177         List[Message]
178             The list of messages after collapsing consecutive messages of the same type.
179         """
180         collapsed_messages = []
181         if not messages:
182             return collapsed_messages
183 
184         previous_message = messages[0]
185         combined_content = self._extract_content(previous_message.content)
186 
187         for current_message in messages[1:]:
188             if current_message.type == previous_message.type:
189                 combined_content += "\n\n" + self._extract_content(
190                     current_message.content
191                 )
192             else:
193                 collapsed_messages.append(
194                     previous_message.__class__(content=combined_content)
195                 )
196                 previous_message = current_message
197                 combined_content = self._extract_content(current_message.content)
198 
199         collapsed_messages.append(previous_message.__class__(content=combined_content))
200         return collapsed_messages
201 
202     def next(
203         self,
204         messages: List[Message],
205         prompt: Optional[str] = None,
206         *,
207         step_name: str,
208     ) -> List[Message]:
209         """
210         Advances the conversation by sending message history
211         to LLM and updating with the response.
212 
213         Parameters
214         ----------
215         messages : List[Message]
216             The list of messages in the conversation.
217         prompt : Optional[str], optional
218             The prompt to use, by default None.
219         step_name : str
220             The name of the step.
221 
222         Returns
223         -------
224         List[Message]
225             The updated list of messages in the conversation.
226         """
227 
228         if prompt:
229             messages.append(HumanMessage(content=prompt))
230 
231         logger.debug(
232             "Creating a new chat completion: %s",
233             "\n".join([m.pretty_repr() for m in messages]),
234         )
235 
236         if not self.vision:
237             messages = self._collapse_text_messages(messages)
238 
239         response = self.backoff_inference(messages)
240 
241         self.token_usage_log.update_log(
242             messages=messages, answer=response.content, step_name=step_name
243         )
244         messages.append(response)
245         logger.debug(f"Chat completion finished: {messages}")
246 
247         return messages
248 
249     @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, openai.RateLimitError, max_tries=7, max_time=45)
250     def backoff_inference(self, messages):
251         """
252         Perform inference using the language model while implementing an exponential backoff strategy.
253 
254         This function will retry the inference in case of a rate limit error from the OpenAI API.
255         It uses an exponential backoff strategy, meaning the wait time between retries increases
256         exponentially. The function will attempt to retry up to 7 times within a span of 45 seconds.
257 
258         Parameters
259         ----------
260         messages : List[Message]
261             A list of chat messages which will be passed to the language model for processing.
262 
263         callbacks : List[Callable]
264             A list of callback functions that are triggered after each inference. These functions
265             can be used for logging, monitoring, or other auxiliary tasks.
266 
267         Returns
268         -------
269         Any
270             The output from the language model after processing the provided messages.
271 
272         Raises
273         ------
274         openai.error.RateLimitError
275             If the number of retries exceeds the maximum or if the rate limit persists beyond the
276             allotted time, the function will ultimately raise a RateLimitError.
277 
278         Example
279         -------
280         >>> messages = [SystemMessage(content="Hello"), HumanMessage(content="How's the weather?")]
281         >>> response = backoff_inference(messages)
282         """
283         return self.llm.invoke(messages)  # type: ignore
284

302     @staticmethod
303     def deserialize_messages(jsondictstr: str) -> List[Message]:
304         """
305         Deserialize a JSON string to a list of messages.
306 
307         Parameters
308         ----------
309         jsondictstr : str
310             The JSON string to deserialize.
311 
312         Returns
313         -------
314         List[Message]
315             The deserialized list of messages.
316         """
317         data = json.loads(jsondictstr)
318         # Modify implicit is_chunk property to ALWAYS false
319         # since Langchain's Message schema is stricter
320         prevalidated_data = [
321             {**item, "tools": {**item.get("tools", {}), "is_chunk": False}}
322             for item in data
323         ]
324         return list(messages_from_dict(prevalidated_data))  # type: ignore
